title: Rava bar Avin
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Pesachim 40a](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.40a.8), and Hyman places him in the time of Rav Nachman and Rav Huna. In [Ketubot 23a](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.23a.8): Rabbi Oshaya taught it on the first clause; Rabbah bar Avin taught it on the last clause.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Pesachim names the households of Rav Huna and Rava bar Avin in Rav Nachman’s remarks.
Ketubot reads Rabbah bar Avin, alongside Rabbi Oshaya. Hyman’s heading has Rava.
